data.name: Erkamun
data.gender_notes: Erkamun is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Erkamun is a name of Arabic and Islamic origin, meaning 'loving, kind, generous'. It is derived from the Arabic word 'erkam' which means 'loving, kind, generous'. The name Erkamun carries the meaning “Loving, kind, generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Erkamun usually hope their child will grow to embody loving, kind, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Erkamun is a name with deep spiritual meaning in Islamic tradition. It symbolizes the qualities of love, kindness, and generosity, which are highly valued in Islamic teachings. Erkamun is a name for a child who is expected to grow up to be a compassionate and caring individual, who puts others before himself and strives to make a positive impact on the world.
data.etymology: Erkamun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Loving, kind, generous.”

in_english.name: Erkamun

in_english.long_meaning: The name Erkamun originates from the Arabic root 'ر-ك-م' (R-K-M), which means to bow down or submit to Allah. In the Quranic context, it refers to individuals who adhere to Allah's commands and submit to His will. Historically, this name was prevalent among the Companions of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). The name signifies obedience, piety, and spiritual devotion. In contemporary Muslim cultures, Erkamun is chosen for its strong religious connotations and positive personality traits such as loyalty and righteousness.
